title: LIVE OVATION AURORA FORECAST
freshness_label: LIVE / CURRENT FORECAST (OVATION Prime, hourly check)
source_name: NOAA/SWPC OVATION Prime aurora model (Aurora Viewline product family)
variable: OVATION Prime auroral intensity ([lon, lat, aurora] 1-degree grid) + forecast Kp / hemispheric power context
temporal: SWPC publishes a new OVATION run about every 5 minutes; this layer checks the source hourly and rebuilds only when the Observation/Forecast time changes
what: Expected auroral intensity over the Great Lakes from NOAA's OVATION Prime model - the same model family behind the NOAA Aurora Viewline product. This is an auroral forecast/prediction, not a guarantee that an observer will see aurora from any specific location.
footprint_note: Rectangular WGS84 footprint inherited exactly from LIVE LEAF COLOR (lon -93..-73.5, lat 40.5..49.5, 1800x1175). Aurora is atmospheric: full rectangle, no shoreline cut. LIVE LEAF COLOR files are never touched.
